source.description: GOAT Hoopers #217 Stage 2 pinned reconstruction inputs: Sleeper-mapped NBA game logs (data/gamelog_mapped.json), a directory projection of the committed Sleeper directory snapshot (data/sleeper_players.json), season history derived deterministically from the same game logs, and the league's two Sleeper draft receipts (committed roster-replay fixtures).
source.revision: gamelog_mapped.json at PR #252 (merge 3bcc19b; 2025-26 mapped sha256 b0a888af), sleeper_players.json committed snapshot, roster-replay fixtures captured 2026-10-21
limitations: Season history is derived from the same committed game logs (per-player per-season games and mean fppg); no external season-total export is pinned. Derived coverage is therefore complete for every listed season and the artifact emits no backtest (annual) points.
Directory birth dates and years_exp are as of the committed snapshot (directorySeason 2026).
Draft picks are the 2025 startup draft (availableOn 2025-10-20) and the 2026 rookie draft (availableOn 2026-10-05); a player in neither draft carries the replacement-level pedigree prior.

Pre-2025-26 minutes in data/gamelog_mapped.json remain in the legacy clock-misread units disclosed on PR #252 (regenerating them is a separate decision). Minutes enter the reconstruction only as cumulative career minutes — the emaAlpha experience input and the prospectWeight pedigree blend (src/data/reconstruct-price-history.ts) — never in trailing production (fppg totals only) and never in annual points (synthetic games x 30). The measured sensitivity of the artifact to decoding those legacy minutes is pinned in data/reconstruction/README.md and guarded by src/data/__tests__/modeled-backfill-inputs.test.ts.
Gamelog fppg omits ff/tf penalties; the source logs carry neither field (inherited from the dataset audit).
